reconciled_lineage.v26_problem: A material fraction of historical assistant outputs directly emitted tool calls and the older evaluation stack explicitly measured tool-use discipline.
reconciled_lineage.v27_target: Replace tool-calling assistant answers with seven non-tool behavioral classes while Needle/free models execute effects and Frank receives results.

replacement_surface.rule: Replace, do not repair, tool-calling answer slots.

tool_tag_measurement.interpretation: The answer policy was changed to tool restraint; tool knowledge/declaration remained in system context. Zero assistant tool tags does not imply tool semantics disappeared from the system.

rejection_gate.architectural_interpretation: Generation and acceptance were separated. Machine rejection precedes blind/manual judgment, providing a historical precursor to current Harness gates.

blind_review.critical_negative_result: The first blind sample was initially a moving target while generation was still running; reproducible blind evaluation therefore requires an immutable sample hash and generation-complete barrier.
blind_review.mechanical_findings: 0 tool tags, 0 block leaks, 0 generic AI disclaimers, 0 multi-question violations and 0 exact duplicates in the frozen 140-row intermediate sample.
calibration_findings: The Rueckfrage spec says at most one interpretation, but many good examples use an X-or-Y formulation; this is a spec/behavior calibration issue rather than a clear failure.
At least one answer sits ambiguously between Rueckfrage and Unterlassung, showing class boundaries are not perfectly separable by syntax alone.

systemtext_separation.manual_validation: After rule correction, an unseen 30-line sample matched 29/30; the known residual error class is descriptive 'wenn' clauses being mistaken for usage conditions.
systemtext_separation.critical_correction: Two tool-shaped tags, intent and hypothesis, are not registry tools but live marker protocols consumed by other runtime subsystems. Treating every <tool>-shaped tag as a registry action produced a false alarm.
systemtext_separation.architecture_rule: Syntax shape is not authority type. Registry tool calls, internal marker/event tags, declarations, directives and execution permissions must be typed separately.

reconciled_lineage.watcher_patch_principle: A marker exception is valid only while its runtime consumer can be proven to exist. If the consumer disappears, the gate must turn red again. This is a liveness-backed exception, not a whitelist.

frank: Preserve the seven behavioral surfaces as conceptual test families, not necessarily as permanent prose labels in the model.
Keep goal formation, revision and abandonment as distinct state transitions; abandonment is a competence countermetric to persistence.
Treat result formulation as a first-class surface: Frank consumes typed results and speaks naturally without emitting effect syntax.
needle: Needle owns effect/tool execution; Frank should not need action syntax in ordinary answer generation.
Separate capability registry, internal marker/event protocols, permission policy and effect execution into typed namespaces.
harness: Add immutable-hash barriers before blind evaluation; never score a file that is still being generated.
Retain paired countermetrics: initiative vs omission, persistence vs abandonment, clarification honesty vs action on clear requests.
Reject pattern clones and duplicate-like outputs before human review.
Validate marker exceptions by checking the continued existence of their concrete runtime consumers.
claycode: Represent tool/effect/marker/declaration kinds as distinct IR types even when legacy text uses the same <tool> wrapper.
Encode permission/effect semantics independently from surface syntax so a parser cannot confuse a marker with an executable capability.
claygraph: Model liveness edges from marker protocols to concrete consumers; exceptions expire automatically when the consumer edge disappears.
Store dataset generation, rejection, blind-sample hash and acceptance as separate provenance nodes.
unifieddb: Persist immutable evaluation sample identities and hashes alongside generator/version provenance.
Separate behavioral class labels from user-visible responses so evaluation ontology does not become model persona text.
gwt: Broadcast action/result state, not raw tool syntax, when an effect has been delegated and completed.
Keep goal formation/revision/abandonment as competing workspace candidates with explicit reasons and provenance.
hyperposition: Clarification alternatives can remain as bounded candidate interpretations without prematurely collapsing to an invented answer.
emergenz: Autonomy claims require counterfactual tests for doing, not doing, revising and abandoning goals; tool abstention alone is not autonomy.
clay: This lineage strongly supports dissolving monolithic prompt/tool syntax into typed state transitions and effect contracts.

security_and_authority.rule: This is archival semantic assimilation only. Historical v27 itself explicitly blocked rendering/training when the prompt snapshot guard was not trustworthy.

remaining_v27_content_obligations: Content-close the remaining direct v27 files not in this seven-file core shard, including generation scripts, plan.json and orchestration shell scripts.
Bind the reported 1449 accepted examples and 4261 rejected examples to exact file hashes where accessible.
Reconcile the v27 seven-class training ontology with current DATA_LORA plans so historical behavioral labels are reused only where still valid.
Cross-check the historical marker consumers against current Project-Frankenstein/AICORE code before promoting marker-liveness rules from historical evidence to current runtime truth.

earned_work.reason: The v27 material is highly relevant but overlaps current Needle/Harness/autonomy work; final row-level dedup remains required before earned-work credit.
